newsitem.title: USA: SpectraScience gets U.S. patent allowance.
newsitem.headline: SpectraScience gets U.S. patent allowance.

text.p: SpectraScience Inc said it was told by the U.S. Patent office that the company's claims have been allowed for a patent application for a system for diagnosing tissue with a guidewire.
SpectraScience is developing minimally invasive devices for testing tissue inside the human body for disease.

The company said it has two U.S. patents related to the use of spectroscopy for diagnosis of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, including heart disease and stroke, and detection of cancer using minimally invasive techniques.
"These patents augment the company's exclusive license agreement with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology covering 31 issued and pending patents," it said.
In addition, the company said it has several patents pending, including both device and method patents, for endoscopic and laparoscopic detection of cancer.
